notes.subject: bel bilong mi i go daun
notes.rationale: בעטף לבי literal 'ol i putim klos long bel bilong mi' — bel i karim hevi i pulap daun.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב → bel (tingting na laik), no hat.

notes.subject: ston i antap moa long mi
notes.rationale: ממני i save tanim 'moa long mi' o 'i no inap long mi' — JPS 'too high for me'.

notes.subject: long yu
notes.rationale: Tok i go street long Yahwe/Elohim.

translation: Long narapela hap bilong graun bai mi singaut long yu; taim bel bilong mi i go daun, yu ken salim mi long rot i go long ston i antap tru, i antap moa long mi.

tokens.gloss: yu ken salim mi long rot
